tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background, and the body of every clay control: clay is the ground itself, pushed up (clay-raised) or pressed in (clay-well).

tokens.name: ground-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed zones: sidebars, code blocks, table stripes. ink and ink-muted stay above 5:1 on it in both flavors.

tokens.name: ground-deep
tokens.usage: Deepest layer: footers, the base under a full-bleed Halo. ink and ink-muted stay legible on it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on ground, ground-sunken, ground-deep, glass-fill and glass-fill-strong (at least 5.9:1 in both flavors, even with a halo behind the glass).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, placeholders, metadata. On every ground and on glass-fill over a halo (at least 4.6:1). Latte uses subtext1: subtext0 is only 4.37:1 on base.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers. Never the only cue that a control exists.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges that must be seen: the field baseline, table rules that carry structure, the outline of any control that has no other part at 3:1. At least 3.2:1 on ground and ground-sunken.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The violet bleed. Focus rings, selection marks, active indicators, icons, the check in a menu. At least 3:1 on every ground. For text use accent-ink.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Links and active labels on any ground or glass. Latte deepens mauve by 2% lightness so it clears 4.5:1 on mantle and crust too.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (9.2:1 Mocha, 4.8:1 Latte).

tokens.name: halo-1
tokens.usage: The warm core, first stop. Starts every halo-1 to halo-2 fill and is the lead blob in a Halo. A fill, never text.

tokens.name: halo-2
tokens.usage: The warm core, second stop, and the second blob in a Halo. A fill, never text.

tokens.name: halo-3
tokens.usage: The bleed: the glow that escapes around a warm-core fill (halo-glow) and the third blob in a Halo. Same hue as accent by design: the glow and the focus ring are one light.

tokens.name: spark
tokens.usage: The cool counter-glow: the fourth blob in a Halo, live or new dots, one data highlight. At most one spark per view. Not text in Latte (3.3:1).

tokens.name: on-halo
tokens.usage: Text and icons on any halo-1 to halo-2 fill: at least 10.6:1 in Mocha, 6.3:1 in Latte. Never white (white on Latte peach is 3:1). Latte borrows Mocha crust.

tokens.name: glass-fill
tokens.usage: Glass panels and cards. Mocha is base lifted a quarter of the way to surface0 at 84%, Latte white at 80%: dense enough that ink-muted keeps 4.6:1 with a full-strength halo blob behind it.

tokens.name: glass-fill-strong
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs: glass that must carry dense text over anything.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: The lit top-left edge of glass (1px gradient border start). Mocha tints it rosewater so edges read warm, like halation.

tokens.name: glass-shade
tokens.usage: The shaded bottom-right edge of glass (gradient border end).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind dialogs and sheets; blur the page under it with blur-glass.

tokens.name: clay-hi
tokens.usage: Lit side of a clay surface's convex gradient (145deg, clay-hi to clay-lo). Within 1.1:1 of ground on purpose: clay is shaped by shadow, not color.

tokens.name: clay-lo
tokens.usage: Shaded side of a clay surface's convex gradient.

tokens.name: thumb
tokens.usage: Switch and slider thumbs at rest: 5.8:1 (Mocha) and 3.5:1 (Latte) against ground, so the control reads without its shadows.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success glyphs and dots. Latte deepens green (2.96:1 on base) to 5.3:1. Pair with a word; status words are set in ink.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind a success chip or banner; ink and success stay legible on it.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning glyphs and dots. Latte deepens yellow (2.3:1) to 5.3:1 amber.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind a warning chip or banner.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions: glyphs, field error rings, error text on ground. Latte deepens red slightly to clear mantle.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind a danger chip or banner.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational glyphs and dots.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind an info chip or banner.

tokens.name: ctp-rosewater
tokens.usage: Catppuccin Rosewater (Mocha #f5e0dc, Latte #dc8a78). Raw palette: syntax colors, charts, illustration. Reach for a semantic token first.

tokens.name: ctp-flamingo
tokens.usage: Catppuccin Flamingo (Mocha #f2cdcd, Latte #dd7878). Raw palette: syntax colors, charts, illustration. Reach for a semantic token first.

tokens.name: ctp-pink
tokens.usage: Catppuccin Pink (Mocha #f5c2e7, Latte #ea76cb). Behind `halo-2`.

tokens.name: ctp-mauve
tokens.usage: Catppuccin Mauve (Mocha #cba6f7, Latte #8839ef). Behind `accent`, `accent-ink`, `halo-3`.

tokens.name: ctp-red
tokens.usage: Catppuccin Red (Mocha #f38ba8, Latte #d20f39). Behind `danger`.

tokens.name: ctp-maroon
tokens.usage: Catppuccin Maroon (Mocha #eba0ac, Latte #e64553). Raw palette: syntax colors, charts, illustration. Reach for a semantic token first.

tokens.name: ctp-peach
tokens.usage: Catppuccin Peach (Mocha #fab387, Latte #fe640b). Behind `halo-1`.

tokens.name: ctp-yellow
tokens.usage: Catppuccin Yellow (Mocha #f9e2af, Latte #df8e1d). Behind `warning`.

tokens.name: ctp-green
tokens.usage: Catppuccin Green (Mocha #a6e3a1, Latte #40a02b). Behind `success`.

tokens.name: ctp-teal
tokens.usage: Catppuccin Teal (Mocha #94e2d5, Latte #179299). Behind `spark`.

tokens.name: ctp-sky
tokens.usage: Catppuccin Sky (Mocha #89dceb, Latte #04a5e5). Raw palette: syntax colors, charts, illustration. Reach for a semantic token first.

tokens.name: ctp-sapphire
tokens.usage: Catppuccin Sapphire (Mocha #74c7ec, Latte #209fb5). Raw palette: syntax colors, charts, illustration. Reach for a semantic token first.

tokens.name: ctp-blue
tokens.usage: Catppuccin Blue (Mocha #89b4fa, Latte #1e66f5). Behind `info`.

tokens.name: ctp-lavender
tokens.usage: Catppuccin Lavender (Mocha #b4befe, Latte #7287fd). Raw palette: syntax colors, charts, illustration. Reach for a semantic token first.

tokens.name: ctp-text
tokens.usage: Catppuccin Text (Mocha #cdd6f4, Latte #4c4f69). Behind `ink`.

tokens.name: ctp-subtext1
tokens.usage: Catppuccin Subtext1 (Mocha #bac2de, Latte #5c5f77). Behind `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: ctp-subtext0
tokens.usage: Catppuccin Subtext0 (Mocha #a6adc8, Latte #6c6f85). Behind `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: ctp-overlay2
tokens.usage: Catppuccin Overlay2 (Mocha #9399b2, Latte #7c7f93). Behind `line-strong`, `thumb`.

tokens.name: ctp-overlay1
tokens.usage: Catppuccin Overlay1 (Mocha #7f849c, Latte #8c8fa1). Raw palette: syntax colors, charts, illustration. Reach for a semantic token first.

tokens.name: ctp-overlay0
tokens.usage: Catppuccin Overlay0 (Mocha #6c7086, Latte #9ca0b0). Behind `line-strong`.

tokens.name: ctp-surface2
tokens.usage: Catppuccin Surface2 (Mocha #585b70, Latte #acb0be). Raw palette: syntax colors, charts, illustration. Reach for a semantic token first.

tokens.name: ctp-surface1
tokens.usage: Catppuccin Surface1 (Mocha #45475a, Latte #bcc0cc). Behind `line`.

tokens.name: ctp-surface0
tokens.usage: Catppuccin Surface0 (Mocha #313244, Latte #ccd0da). Behind `line`.

tokens.name: ctp-base
tokens.usage: Catppuccin Base (Mocha #1e1e2e, Latte #eff1f5). Behind `ground`, `on-accent`.

tokens.name: ctp-mantle
tokens.usage: Catppuccin Mantle (Mocha #181825, Latte #e6e9ef). Behind `ground-sunken`, `clay-lo`.

tokens.name: ctp-crust
tokens.usage: Catppuccin Crust (Mocha #11111b, Latte #dce0e8). Behind `ground-deep`, `on-accent`, `on-halo`.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Bricolage Grotesque, variable (opsz 12-96, wdth 75-100, wght 200-800). Big, tight, and set on the ground or on glass; never on a warm-core fill.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per page: the hero line. Scale with clamp(56px, 9vw, 112px). May carry one flourish word.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Card and panel heads on large surfaces. clamp(32px, 4vw, 44px).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles, dialog titles, menu section heads.

groups.name: Flourish
groups.note: Instrument Serif italic, one word at a time. Latin only: Vietnamese diacritics fall back to Georgia, so keep flourishes to English words.

styles.name: flourish
styles.usage: One or two words inside a display line, matched to that line's size. Never a whole sentence, never body copy.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Geist, variable. Everything that is read rather than seen.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Glass floats over content, clay rests on the page, and the halo marks the one thing that matters.
styles.usage: Lead paragraphs under a display line. Max 60ch.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Menus open from where you clicked and close faster than they came.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, field labels, menu items, segmented options.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Hints under fields, metadata, chip text.

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: Geist Mono. Code, numbers that align, and the overline.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Section indices above display lines. Uppercase it in CSS (text-transform: uppercase); pair with a number.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline and block code, on ground-sunken.

spacing.note: 4px base, opening up fast at the top: layouts breathe, controls stay tight.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in chips; hairline offsets.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in buttons; menu padding; gap between menu items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside small controls; label-to-field gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Control horizontal padding; gaps in a control row.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between fields.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding on glass; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections on mobile; hero padding.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Between sections on desktop. Awwwards-scale air: do not compress it.

radius.note: Generous and soft: clay is molded, glass is polished. A nested radius is the outer radius minus the padding between them.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, small icon buttons, menu items (via the nesting rule).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, dropdown triggers, segmented tracks.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero glass panels and full-bleed Halo frames.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Switches, pills, dots, thumbs.

shadow.note: Clay shadows are paired light/dark (neumorph) and only on ground-colored surfaces; glass gets glass-float; the warm core gets halo-glow. Never mix clay shadows onto glass.

tokens.name: clay-raised
tokens.usage: Clay controls at rest: buttons, dropdown triggers, segmented thumbs, cards that sit on the page. All four clay shadows share one five-layer shape so rest, lift, press and well interpolate smoothly.

tokens.name: clay-lift
tokens.usage: Clay on hover: the surface rises toward the pointer (pair with translateY(-1px)).

tokens.name: clay-pressed
tokens.usage: Clay while pressed, a dropdown trigger while its menu is open, the on state of toggle buttons: the surface sinks under the finger.

tokens.name: clay-well
tokens.usage: Permanent hollows: field wells, switch and segmented tracks, progress troughs.

tokens.name: clay-sm
tokens.usage: Small raised parts: switch thumbs, chips, the segmented thumb.

tokens.name: glass-float
tokens.usage: Glass that floats: menus, popovers, glass cards over a Halo.

tokens.name: halo-glow
tokens.usage: The bleed around a warm-core fill at rest: mauve outside, peach close in.

tokens.name: halo-glow-lift
tokens.usage: The bleed on hover: wider and brighter, as if the light came closer.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on everything: a 2px ground gap, then 2px solid accent (8.1:1 Mocha, 4.8:1 Latte on ground). Listed first in any box-shadow it joins.

blur.note: backdrop-filter radii. Always pair glass blur with saturate(170%): the colors behind should bleed through richer than they are.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: Glass cards and panels: backdrop-filter: blur(22px) saturate(170%).

tokens.name: blur-glass-strong
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and scrims, where legibility beats see-through.

tokens.name: blur-halo
tokens.usage: Softening Halo blobs when drawn as shapes instead of radial gradients.

opacity.note: Grain is the texture of the whole system: it sits on every halo fill and every Halo.

tokens.name: grain-strength
tokens.usage: Grain over warm-core fills and Halo backdrops (mix-blend-mode: overlay). Latte uses grain-strength-soft.

tokens.name: grain-strength-soft
tokens.usage: Grain on glass, and on everything in Latte, where overlay grain reads dirtier.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls: drop to this opacity and remove every shadow except the well.

duration.note: Enter slower than you exit. Press faster than you hover.

tokens.name: dur-press
tokens.usage: Press down: scale, sink into clay-pressed.

tokens.name: dur-hover
tokens.usage: Hover lift, glow growth, color shifts, the label roll.

tokens.name: dur-exit
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers closing.

tokens.name: dur-enter
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers opening, fields waking on focus.

tokens.name: dur-slide
tokens.usage: Things that travel: switch thumbs, segmented thumbs, the menu hover pill, a release after press.

tokens.name: dur-stagger
tokens.usage: Delay step between menu items as they arrive. Cap the cascade at 8 items.

tokens.name: dur-ambient
tokens.usage: One slow drift cycle of Halo blobs. Paused under prefers-reduced-motion.

easing.note: Two characters: expo-out for things that appear, spring for things that travel.

tokens.name: ease-out-expo
tokens.usage: Entrances: menus, popovers, focus halos, hover lift.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Travel with a small overshoot: thumbs, the hover pill, chevrons, release after press.

tokens.name: ease-press
tokens.usage: Press-down only: quick in, no bounce.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Exits: accelerate away, never linger.
